about: One forged load-skill call, read by BOTH sides. The Rust test (raisin-flow-runtime handlers/ai_container/skill_grant.rs) runs model_tool_call through an ai_container step whose callback granted server_grant, and asserts the function was executed with executed_arguments exactly. The JS test (content/functions/lib/raisin/ai/load-skill/index.test.mjs) hands executed_arguments to load-skill and asserts it refuses forged_skill and never reads it.
